title: Quick Japanese Bread Flour Casserole
description: A fresh, molten one-pot casserole that blends bread flour with Japanese seasonings and a lacquer‑glaze finish.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200°C and lightly oil a 20 cm square baking dish.
In a bowl, dissolve the yeast and sugar in the dashi stock and let sit for 5 minutes until frothy.
Whisk the flour and salt together, then add the yeast mixture and soy sauce to form a loose dough.
Knead the dough on a floured surface for 2 minutes until smooth, then transfer it to the prepared dish.
Roll the mozzarella into thin ribbons and lay them across the dough for a molten center.
Sprinkle the toasted nori flakes, sliced scallion, and grated ginger over the dough.
Drizzle the vegetable oil over the top and bake for 20 minutes until the edges are golden and the cheese is bubbling.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it rest for 3 minutes before slicing.
Serve warm, optionally drizzle extra soy‑mirin glaze on top for added shine.
Enjoy the chewy bread base with a silky, molten cheese core and fragrant Japanese flavors.
